literal_meaning: ঘাড় ধরে ধরে কাজ করানো (holding by the neck and making to do)
figurative_meaning_en: To force someone to do something; to compel by force
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা ছেলেকে ঘাড় ধরে করানো করে পড়াশোনা করিয়েছে।
প্রধানমন্ত্রী বিরোধীদের ঘাড় ধরে করানো করে আইন পাস করিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The father forced his son to study by holding him by the neck.
The boss strong-armed the employees into working overtime.
note: This idiom draws from imagery of physical restraint, common in rural and everyday Bengali expressions of dominance.
